notes.title: Fixed the Issue Where Wordo May Disappear in Certain Situations in the Demo
notes.content:
Hello, fellow enthusiasts we have yet to meet![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159778/ed08c04db6932226f5f092c276bf4fa00fcf06cc.png[/img]



Based on player feedback, we discovered a bug in the demo version where "[b]Wordo may disappear when returning to the map from certain levels.[/b]" After an urgent investigation, we have successfully fixed the issue and released a new version.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and trouble this has caused our players.



We would like to extend a special thanks to players【DDtective】,【shpasic】, and【crab】!
It is your feedback and enthusiasm that enable us to continually improve the quality of Wordban[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159778/6911b72ff967f7062646bbc620c94c5ff6add96c.png[/img]



Moving forward, please continue to follow and support Wordban as we accompany Wordo to the very end.



Black Banana Studio
Beibi Technology Co., Ltd.

notes.title: Fixed the Missing Audio Bug in the Demo Version
notes.content:
Hello, fellow enthusiasts we have yet to meet![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45159778/6911b72ff967f7062646bbc620c94c5ff6add96c.png[/img]



First and foremost, please accept our sincerest apologies. Thanks to the feedback from one of our players, we discovered a bug in the demo where the audio and sound effects were missing. After a thorough investigation, we have successfully fixed the issue and released a new version. We deeply regret not being able to ensure a complete gaming experience in time, and we apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.



At the same time, we are incredibly grateful for your patience and support. It is your feedback and enthusiasm that drive us to continually improve and refine the quality of Wordban.



Looking ahead, we will continue to give our all to bring you more and better Sokoban puzzle experiences. Please keep following and supporting Wordban as we walk this journey with Wordo together.


Black Banana Studio
Beibi Technology Co., Ltd.
